# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** Praise to God the Just Provider

---

**5:1** O LORD God, I will praise thy name in joy;
in the midst of those who know thy righteous judgments.

**5:2** For thou art good and merciful, the hope of the poor;
for who is like thee, O God?

**5:3** I will praise thy name with those who love thee;
for thou art good and full of mercy upon Israel.

**5:4** Blessed are those born in those days,
to see the good things of Israel when God gathers the tribes.

**5:5** May God cleanse Israel for the day of mercy and blessing,
for the day of choice when he brings back his anointed.

**5:6** Blessed are those who shall be in those days,
to see the good things of the LORD that he shall perform for the generation to come,

**5:7** under the rod of chastening of the LORD's anointed,
in the fear of his God, in the spirit of wisdom and righteousness and strength:

**5:8** that he may direct every man in the works of righteousness by the fear of God,
that he may establish them all before the LORD in a good generation.

**5:9** Blessed are they that shall be born in those days
to see the good things of the LORD which he shall do for the generation that is to come.

**5:10** May the mercy of the LORD be upon Israel forever and ever.

**5:11** For thou, O God, art our king forever and ever;
and in thee, O God, will our soul glory.

**5:12** How long is the time of a man's life upon the earth?
as is his time, so also is his hope upon him.

**5:13** But we hope in God our savior;
for the might of our God is forever with mercy,
and the kingdom of our God is forever over the nations, judging.

**5:14** Thou, O LORD, didst choose Abraham above all the nations
and didst set thy covenant upon him and his seed forever.

**5:15** And thou didst not turn away from us;
thou didst gather from the scattering of strangers our dispersed of Israel.

**5:16** The great and holy LORD our God;
and the strength of our God is in Jerusalem forever.

**5:17** And the mercy of the LORD is upon the houses of Israel
forever and ever.

**5:18** For the LORD spares his devout ones
and he blots out their mistakes by his discipline.

**5:19** For the life of the righteous goes on forever;
but sinners shall be taken away into destruction, and their memorial shall be found no more.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Greek (Codex Vindobonensis). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
